verdict.line: You lose if you stand and auto-trade into a charged Granite Shield or a Brutal Strikes buff; you win if you poke the shield down first and then stun-engage the moment his E (Ground Slam) is on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Malphite's passive, Granite Shield, absorbs a chunk of whatever burst hits it first and only recharges if he hasn't been hit recently — so Irelia's normal Q (Bladesurge) dash-in gets partially eaten unless the shield is already down from prior chip damage. Layer on Ground Slam, a 400-range shockwave on a 7s cooldown that reduces attack speed, and standing in extended auto trades is a losing pattern. The 45.2% win rate over 2,245 games reflects players trading like it's a normal duel instead of a shield-bait-then-burst matchup.

theirWindow.when: Both Q and E are up on his bar
theirWindow.what: He can steal your movement speed with Q (Seismic Shard, 625 range, 8s CD) as you close in, then hit the attack-speed-reducing shockwave from E (400 range, 7s CD) right as you try to auto. Back off and let a minion or poke tick his shield instead of walking into both.

yourWindow.what: With his attack-speed shockwave down, dash in with Q (Bladesurge), land E (Flawless Duet) for the stun and Mark, then Q again off the Mark for the free cooldown refresh and healing — chain it fast before Granite Shield has time to recharge.

start.why: The dominant start at 45% win rate over 2,286 games — the lifesteal and AD keep you topped off through his Q pokes and let you threaten a trade the moment his shield is down.

boots.why: Higher pick rate and win rate than Plated Steelcaps here; the magic resist blunts his Q and E magic damage, and the tenacity shortens how long his R (Unstoppable Force) knockup keeps you locked down.

core.why: Percent current-health damage ignores how much armor and HP he stacks, making it the single best tool for actually killing a tank who out-scales you on raw stats.
Isolated-target bonus damage rewards exactly the 1v1 duels this matchup is built around, and the highest-win-rate core path (57.5%) runs it second.
Attack speed feeds your passive, Ionian Fervor, into max stacks faster, and the magic resist directly answers his magic Q and E.

situational.when: he or his team builds up burst damage and you need the damage-over-time conversion to survive extended fights
he stacks resistances evenly and you need the alternating penetration to keep your on-hit damage relevant
you're ahead in gold and want to close out duels faster instead of sustaining through them

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through your dash-in-and-auto combo and the healing offsets his Q poke damage during the window before you commit to a full all-in.

summoners.why: The highest win rate (46.6%) and by far the most-picked combo (65.4%) — Ignite punishes his shield-recharge sustain and secures kills in the short stun-burst window E (Flawless Duet) opens up.

playing.title: Bait the shield before committing
playing.detail: Granite Shield only recharges if he hasn't been hit recently. Land a minion auto or a ranged poke first so your Q (Bladesurge) all-in isn't partially absorbed.

playing.title: Engage only when his E is down
playing.detail: Ground Slam (400 range, 7s cooldown) reduces your attack speed the instant you try to stand and auto. Walk up right after he uses it, not into it.

playing.title: Respect Q range, don't try to dodge it
playing.detail: Seismic Shard is targeted at you from 625 range, not a skillshot — staying outside that range is the only way to avoid the speed steal, juking won't work.

playing.title: Chain E into Q for the reset
playing.detail: Flawless Duet stuns and Marks; a Marked target refreshes Bladesurge's cooldown on hit, so land E first, then Q in for the free dash, heal, and extra damage.

playing.title: Charge W when Brutal Strikes is up
playing.detail: His W activation spikes his armor and AD for a few seconds. Charging Defiant Dance during that window uses its physical damage reduction to blunt the buffed autos.

playing.title: Play around his level 6 all-in
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force charges 1000 range and knocks up on a 130/115/100s cooldown. Stay near a wall or minions you can juke behind rather than fighting in the open river.

playing.title: Rush Blade of The Ruined King for relevance
playing.detail: Percent-health damage is what actually lets you punish his tank stacking; prioritize finishing it before Hullbreaker so your trades scale before his armor does.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures above are pulled from measured games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade-timing advice are my own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Engage combat whenever Malphite’s (E) is on cooldown. Avoid being hit with (Q) too often while closing in to deal damage.
